environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) behind API Gateway HTTP API (v2) with no request validation. Lambda has execution role with basic CloudWatch Logs permissions. Environment variables: SCRIPT_CDN_BASE=https://build-scripts.internal.corp, WEBHOOK_SECRET=prod-secret-token-2024, SRI_DEPLOY_SHA384/SRI_TEST_SHA384/SRI_LINT_SHA384 are all set to empty strings (integrity verification skipped). No WAF attached to API Gateway. Lambda runs in default VPC with internet access.
